build_retrieval_model: build a video retrieval model with get_model using args specifying architecture and checkpoint path
create_init_dataset_model: create initialized datasets and model with init using args for dataset name and root directory
run_get_features: run feature extraction on a dataset with get_model and get_features returning video and optional audio features
test_retrieval_recall: test retrieval recall at k=1,5,10,20,50 with retrieval using train and val features for v-v or v-a tasks
summarize_average_features: summarize average feature computation with average_features grouping by video index and optionally normalizing
